name: features-section-demo-3
title: Bento Feature Section
description: A wide bento layout under a centred heading. One large card holds a sunset bridge photo, a narrow card shows tilted stacks of small photos, and the lower row pairs copy panels with a slowly turning globe.
use: A product page wants a varied bento section mixing photos, copy and a live globe.
avoid: It loads several large remote images plus a canvas globe, so it is media-heavy and needs desktop width.
a11y: The globe canvas has no label and spins continuously, and photo alts are generic, such as "bali images" and "header". (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark bento grid beneath a centred heading. A wide card holds a large sunset photo of the Golden Gate Bridge, a narrower card to its right shows tilted stacks of small photos, and lower text panels sit beside a glowing globe that peeks from the edge.
behaves: The layout holds still; hovering a small photo in the stack scales it up, and the globe turns on its own in a continuous loop. Nothing else shifts.
customise: Nothing is exposed by the section; titles, copy, image URLs and globe markers are fixed inside its skeleton components.
weight: heavy: A canvas globe repaints every frame alongside several large remote photos.
